newsitem.title: UK: Phonelink names Ramsey chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Phonelink names Ramsey chief executive.

text.p: UK electronic information and commercial services company Phonelink Plc said Graham Ramsey has been appointed chief executive and group managing director and will take up his position early in the new year.
Ramsey joins Phonelink from United News & Media where he is currently group managing director of United Advertising Publications.
Phonelink said Ramsey would have sole responsibility for the operational running of the company's activities.

It said company founder Trevor Burke would "concentrate his vision and innovative skills in creating the products of the future and developing strategic partnerships." -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
